paragraphs.text: Silvar is a giant Cat Nightmare from Ikoria . Its bonder is Trynn .

Unlike other bonders, Trynn remained in Drannith after her eludha , living apart from Silvar, who resides in the chasms of the surrounding Savai triome . She keeps her identity as a bonder secret, working to make the city a safe place for other bonders and their companions. As a former Coppercoat , she has firsthand knowledge of the corruption within the city's government. Now when she runs across corrupt officials, she lures them outside the city and feeds them to her partner, Silvar.
